name: vibe-gambit
description: Play chess on Lichess while Claude Code works: the board in a pane, live games against a random opponent, a friend or Stockfish hosted on Lichess.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; English otherwise.

gameScope.title: Game scope
gameScope.description: global: the same game in every Claude Code session. conversation: one game per conversation, found again when you resume it.

hintWhenHidden.title: Game line under the prompt
hintWhenHidden.description: While the board is hidden, show both clocks, the opponent's last move and whose turn it is at the end of the hint line under the prompt.
